en.Abgeschaltet oder noch nicht eingerichte: Switched off or not yet set up
en.Abspielen zeigt jeden der letzten 7 Tage: Playback shows each of the last 7 days one by one.
en.Bis zum 12. Oktober 2026 hießen die Stuf: Until 12 October 2026 the ratings were called “Confirmed”, “Likely”, “Unconfirmed”, “Disputed” and “False”. They were renamed “Supported by independent sources”, “Partly supported”, “Unverified”, “Conflicting evidence” and “Refuted”; the history shows the old name.
en.Damals eingetragen als „{old}“ (Stufen v: Recorded at the time as “{old}” (ratings before 13 October 2026)
en.Die Art eines Ereignisses (Militär, Gefe: Semay recognises the type of an event (military, clashes, border, politics, diplomacy, shipping, humanitarian situation, disinformation, infrastructure) automatically from keywords in the headline. This can be wrong and is marked as automatic everywhere.
en.Diese Meldung ist älter als 7 Tage und n: This report is older than 7 days and no longer available. Saved reports stay under “Saved”.
en.Fläche: Eine Meldung nennt den Ort. Erwä: Area: a report names the place. Mentioned, not located; we do not know exactly where something happened.
en.Genau: gemessen von Satelliten oder Sens: Exact: measured by satellites or sensors (heat spots about 375 m, earthquake epicentre)
en.Gestrichelt: Regionsgrenzen. Umstritten:: Dashed: regional boundaries. Disputed: Western Tigray/Welkait, Raya, Badme, Las Anod. Boundaries from Natural Earth. Darfur lies west of the map area.
en.Hitzepunkte gibt es nur für die letzten: Heat spots are only available for the last 24 hours; they stay the same during playback.
en.Hängen die Quellen voneinander ab? (opti: Do the sources depend on each other? (optional)
en.In 24 Stunden {runs} Abrufe, davon {fail: In 24 hours {runs} fetches, {failed} of them failed. {fresh} new reports saved, {dupes} already known ones skipped.
en.Ist die Datenlage zu dünn (weniger als d: If the data is too thin (fewer than three reports in the period or many sources down), “At a glance” says so explicitly instead of claiming a situation. Below it we list what we cannot see right now.
en.Jede Quelle ist nach Art eingeordnet, da: Each source is classified by type so you can weigh reports. Tap to see the register: publisher, language, focus, known limitations and the last fetch.
en.Jeder Beleg ist gekennzeichnet: Er stütz: Each piece of evidence is labelled: it supports the claim, contradicts it or only puts it in context. Where sources depend on each other (for example the same government statement), this is noted with the claim.
en.Medien verschiedener Art; das heißt nich: Media of different kinds; this does not mean it is true
en.Nichts gefunden zu „{query}“. Andere Sch: Nothing found for “{query}”. Try another spelling, e.g. Aseb instead of Assab, or English. The search covers headlines from the last 7 days.
en.Nur Geschichten, über die Medien verschi: Only stories reported by media of different kinds
en.Ohne erreichbare Quelle: {list}. Wir kön: No reachable source: {list}. We cannot show what this side says.
en.Orte: Messwerte (Hitzepunkte, Erdbeben): Places: measurements (heat spots, earthquakes) have exact coordinates. Incidents at sea are located approximately, as UKMTO gives them. Reports are never placed on a point: if a headline names a place, the map shows an area around it marked “mentioned, not located”. Without a place name a report does not appear on the map.
en.Schlagzeilen gehören zusammen, wenn sie: Headlines belong together if they share rare words{shared} and are at most 48 hours apart. This happens automatically and can be wrong. “No report yet” refers to the reachable sources of the last 7 days; headlines in Tigrinya, Amharic or Arabic are not grouped.
en.So, wie die Quelle ihn nennt, z. B. „in: As the source gives it, e.g. “on the night of 8 to 9 October”
en.Ungefähr: Vorfälle auf See, so wie UKMTO: Approximate: incidents at sea, as UKMTO gives them
en.Unklar: Meldungen ohne bekannten Ortsnam: Unclear: reports without a known place name are not on the map.
en.Warum diese Stufe, in ein bis zwei Sätze: Why this rating, in one or two sentences
en.Was fehlt, um weiter zu prüfen?: What is missing to check further?
en.Was wir trotzdem wissen, steht darunter;: What we do know is listed below; each line names its source.
en.Werden von Semay nicht gesondert erfasst: Not tracked separately by Semay; the source's own site is authoritative.
en.Zeitraum für Meldungen, Erdbeben und Vor: Period for reports, earthquakes and incidents at sea
en.Zu jeder Behauptung stehen, soweit bekan: For each claim we show, as far as known: who made it, when it was first reported, when the event is said to have happened, the reason for the rating, open questions and the date of the last check.
en.z. B. beide Berichte stützen sich auf di: e.g. both reports rely on the same government statement
en.{found} im Feed, {kept} zu unseren Regio: {found} in the feed, {kept} on our regions, {fresh} new, {dupes} already known
en.{n} Quellen sind abgeschaltet oder noch: {n} sources are switched off or not yet set up, including GDELT, ReliefWeb and ACLED.
en.{n} weitere Meldungen nennen keinen Ort,: {n} more reports name no place Semay knows and are not on the map.
en.{period} gab es nur {count} zu Eritrea,: {period} there were only {count} on Eritrea, Ethiopia and Tigray.
en.{period} keine Meldung zu Eritrea, Äthio: No report on Eritrea, Ethiopia and Tigray in our sources {period}.
en.{period} keine Meldung zu: {list}. Das h: No report {period} on: {list}. This does not mean nothing happened there.
en.„Durch unabhängige Quellen gestützt“ bra: “Supported by independent sources” needs two independent sources (a copied agency report counts once) or an admission by the side concerned.
“Supported by independent sources” needs two independent sources on two different websites or an admission by the side concerned.
en.„Widerlegt“ braucht mindestens einen Bel: “Refuted” needs at least one piece of evidence that shows it.
en.… die Behauptung stützen, ihr widersprec: … support the claim, contradict it or only put it in context. Shown in the history next to the evidence.
en.Gemeldet, aber noch nicht anhand von Bel: Reported, but not yet checked against evidence.
Currently being checked against evidence. No result yet.
en.Belege stützen einen Teil der Aussage, o: Evidence supports part of the statement, or so far only one independent source supports it.
en.Mindestens zwei voneinander unabhängige: At least two sources independent of each other support it, or the side concerned admits it.
en.Es gibt Belege dafür und Belege dagegen;: There is evidence for and against; neither clearly outweighs the other.
Evidence shows it is not true.
en.Mit frei zugänglichen Belegen nicht zu p: Cannot be checked with freely available evidence, for example because nobody has independent access.
en.Medien aus Somalia und Somaliland. Wie j: Media from Somalia and Somaliland. Like any single source, not confirmation on its own.
Sudanese media, including from exile. Not a party to the war; like any single source, not confirmation on its own.
en.Letzter Abruf erfolgreich, innerhalb der: Last fetch successful, within the last 3 hours.
en.Erreichbar, aber in 24 Stunden keine Mel: Reachable, but no report on our regions in 24 hours.
en.Seit über 3 Stunden kein erfolgreicher A: No successful fetch for over 3 hours, or no new report on our regions for over 14 days.
en.Der letzte Abruf ist gescheitert. Angeze: The last fetch failed. Shown is the state of the last success.
en.Die Quelle lehnt unsere Abfragen ab. Wir: The source refuses our requests. We do not get around blocks.
No fetch yet since it was set up.
en.Bewusst abgeschaltet; der Grund steht da: Deliberately switched off; the reason is given.
en.Die Schnittstelle verlangt seit November: Since November 2025 the API requires a pre-approved app name. The request goes through a ReliefWeb form and must be made by the operator.
en.ACLED verlangt ein Konto und einen Zugan: ACLED requires an account and an access key; its terms of use restrict passing on the data. Usable only after registration and a review of the terms.
en.Die Quelle nennt keine Zeit · abgerufen: The source gives no time · fetched {got}
en.Das Abruf-Protokoll hat noch keine Eintr: The fetch log has no entries from the last 24 hours yet.

ti.Abspielen zeigt jeden der letzten 7 Tage: ምጽዋት ነፍሲ ወከፍ ካብተን ናይ መወዳእታ 7 መዓልትታት በበይኑ የርኢ።
ti.Bis zum 12. Oktober 2026 hießen die Stuf: ክሳብ 12 ጥቅምቲ 2026 እቶም ደረጃታት «ዝተረጋገጸ»፡ «ክኸውን ዝኽእል»፡ «ዘይተረጋገጸ»፡ «ዘካትዕ»ን «ሓሶት»ን ይበሃሉ ነበሩ። ሕጂ «ብናጻ ምንጭታት ዝተደገፈ»፡ «ብኸፊል ዝተደገፈ»፡ «ዘይተመርመረ»፡ «ዝጋጮ መርትዖ»ን «ዝተነጸገ»ን ተባሂሎም፤ እቲ ታሪኽ ነቲ ናይ ቀደም ስም ይጠቅስ።
ti.Die Art eines Ereignisses (Militär, Gefe: ሰማይ ዓይነት ፍጻመ (ወተሃደራዊ፡ ውግኣት፡ ዶብ፡ ፖለቲካ፡ ዲፕሎማሲ፡ መጓዓዝያ ባሕሪ፡ ሰብኣዊ ኩነታት፡ ጌጋ ሓበሬታ፡ መሰረተ ልምዓት) ካብ ቀንዲ ቃላት ኣርእስቲ ብኣውቶማቲክ ይፈልጦ። እዚ ክጋገ ይኽእል እዩ፡ ኣብ ኩሉ ቦታ ከኣ ከም ኣውቶማቲክ ተመልኪቱ ኣሎ።
ti.Diese Meldung ist älter als 7 Tage und n: እዚ ጸብጻብ ልዕሊ 7 መዓልቲ ዝኣረገ ስለዝኾነ ድሕሪ ሕጂ ኣይርከብን። ዝተዓቀቡ ጸብጻባት ኣብ «ዝተዓቀበ» ይጸንሑ።
ti.Fläche: Eine Meldung nennt den Ort. Erwä: ከባቢ፦ ሓደ ጸብጻብ ነቲ ቦታ ይጠቅሶ። ተጠቒሱ እምበር ኣይተረጋገጸን፤ ኣበይ ብልክዕ ገለ ከም ዘጋጠመ ኣይንፈልጥን።
ti.Genau: gemessen von Satelliten oder Sens: ልክዕ፦ ብሳተላይትን መለክዒታትን ዝተዓቀነ (ነጥብታት ሙቐት ኣስታት 375 ሜ፡ ማእከል ምንቕጥቃጥ ምድሪ)
ti.Gestrichelt: Regionsgrenzen. Umstritten:: ነጠብጣብ መስመር፦ ዶባት ክልላት። ዘካትዑ፦ ምዕራብ ትግራይ/ወልቃይት፡ ራያ፡ ባድመ፡ ላስ ዓኖድ። ዶባት ካብ Natural Earth። ዳርፉር ብምዕራብ ካብቲ ካርታ ወጻኢ እዩ።
ti.Hitzepunkte gibt es nur für die letzten: ነጥብታት ሙቐት ንናይ መወዳእታ 24 ሰዓት ጥራይ ኣለዉ፤ ኣብ ግዜ ምጽዋት ኣይቅየሩን።
ti.Hängen die Quellen voneinander ab? (opti: እቶም ምንጭታት ኣብ ሓድሕዶም ይምርኮሱ ዶ? (ኣማራጺ)
ti.In 24 Stunden {runs} Abrufe, davon {fail: ኣብ 24 ሰዓት {runs} ምምጻእ፡ ካብኡ {failed} ፈሺሉ። {fresh} ሓደሽቲ ጸብጻባት ተዓቂቦም፡ {dupes} ዝነበሩ ተሰጊሮም።
ti.Ist die Datenlage zu dünn (weniger als d: እቲ ሓበሬታ እንተዊሒዱ (ኣብቲ ግዜ ካብ ሰለስተ ዝወሓዱ ጸብጻባት ወይ ብዙሓት ዝተበላሸዉ ምንጭታት)፡ «ብሓጺሩ» ኩነታት ካብ ምባል ንላዕሊ ብግልጺ ይገልጾ። ኣብ ታሕቲ ድማ ሕጂ ክንርእዮ ዘይንኽእል ይጠቅስ።
ti.Jede Quelle ist nach Art eingeordnet, da: ጸብጻባት ክትምዝን ምእንቲ ነፍሲ ወከፍ ምንጪ ብዓይነቱ ተመዲቡ ኣሎ። ምጥዋቕ ነቲ መዝገብ የርኢ፦ ኣሕታሚ፡ ቋንቋ፡ ትኹረት፡ ዝፍለጡ ደረታትን ናይ መወዳእታ ምምጻእን።
ti.Jeder Beleg ist gekennzeichnet: Er stütz: ነፍሲ ወከፍ መርትዖ ተመልኪቱ ኣሎ፦ ነቲ ዝተባህለ ይድግፎ፡ ይቃወሞ ወይ ኣብ ኣውድ ጥራይ የቐምጦ። ምንጭታት ኣብ ሓድሕዶም ኣብ ዝምርኮስሉ (ንኣብነት ሓደ መግለጺ መንግስቲ)፡ እዚ ምስቲ ዝተባህለ ተጻሒፉ ኣሎ።
ti.Medien verschiedener Art; das heißt nich: ዝተፈላለየ ዓይነት ማዕከናት፤ እዚ ሓቂ እዩ ማለት ኣይኮነን
ti.Nichts gefunden zu „{query}“. Andere Sch: ን«{query}» ዝኾነ ኣይተረኽበን። ካልእ ኣጻሕፋ ፈትኑ፡ ንኣብነት ኣሰብ ኣብ ክንዲ ዓሰብ፡ ወይ ብእንግሊዝኛ። ምድላይ ኣብ ኣርእስትታት ናይ መወዳእታ 7 መዓልትታት እዩ።
ti.Nur Geschichten, über die Medien verschi: ብዝተፈላለየ ዓይነት ማዕከናት ዝተጸብጸቡ ዛንታታት ጥራይ
ti.Ohne erreichbare Quelle: {list}. Wir kön: ዝበጽሕ ምንጪ የለን፦ {list}። እዚ ወገን እንታይ ከም ዝብል ከነርኢ ኣይንኽእልን።
ti.Orte: Messwerte (Hitzepunkte, Erdbeben): ቦታታት፦ ዓቐናት (ነጥብታት ሙቐት፡ ምንቕጥቃጥ ምድሪ) ልክዕ ኣቀማምጣ ኣለዎም። ፍጻመታት ኣብ ባሕሪ ከም ዝሃቦም UKMTO ብግምት ይቕመጡ። ጸብጻባት ፈጺሞም ኣብ ሓንቲ ነጥቢ ኣይቕመጡን፦ ኣርእስቲ ቦታ እንተጠቒሱ፡ እቲ ካርታ ከባቢኡ ብ«ተጠቒሱ፡ ኣይተረጋገጸን» የርኢ። ስም ቦታ ዘይብሉ ጸብጻብ ኣብ ካርታ ኣይርአን።
ti.Schlagzeilen gehören zusammen, wenn sie: ኣርእስትታት ሳሕቲ ዝርከቡ ቃላት እንተተኻፊሎም{shared}ን ብዝበዝሐ 48 ሰዓት እንተተፈላሊዮምን ሓደ እዮም። እዚ ብኣውቶማቲክ ስለ ዝኸውን ክጋገ ይኽእል። «ገና ጸብጻብ የለን» ንዝበጽሑ ምንጭታት ናይ መወዳእታ 7 መዓልትታት ይምልከት፤ ብትግርኛ፡ ኣምሓርኛ ወይ ዓረብ ዝተጻሕፉ ኣርእስትታት ኣይጥርነፉን።
ti.Ungefähr: Vorfälle auf See, so wie UKMTO: ብግምት፦ ፍጻመታት ኣብ ባሕሪ፡ ከም ዝሃቦም UKMTO
ti.Unklar: Meldungen ohne bekannten Ortsnam: ዘይንጹር፦ ፍሉጥ ስም ቦታ ዘይብሎም ጸብጻባት ኣብ ካርታ የለዉን።
ti.Warum diese Stufe, in ein bis zwei Sätze: ስለምንታይ እዚ ደረጃ፡ ብሓደ ወይ ክልተ ምሉእ ሓሳባት
ti.Was wir trotzdem wissen, steht darunter;: ዝፈለጥናዮ ኣብ ታሕቲ ኣሎ፤ ነፍሲ ወከፍ መስመር ምንጩ ይጠቅስ።
